draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline reported a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: The claim states Tessaline "significantly outperformed" Varrow-NMT in BLEU. The package reports BLEU means (28.4 vs 27.6) but the only statistical test (S1) is for Tessaline vs PhraseGrid (cmp2), not vs Varrow-NMT (cmp1). No significance test is reported for the Tessaline–Varrow comparison, so "significantly" is unsupported. The numeric values are correct.
